comments.text:
Indonesia has more than 17,000 islands and hundreds of cultures — but which part of this documentary surprised you the most?

The Bajau sea nomads, the Korowai tree houses, Mentawai traditions, Torajan funeral customs, Nyepi in Bali, or Jakarta sinking?

👇 Tell me which one you would want to see as a full documentary next.
